description.zh: 模糊搜索关键词。仅支持实体的name字段，且大小写不敏感
description.en: A keyword for a case-insensitive fuzzy search on the `name` field of projects.

description.zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
description.en: An array of label selectors to filter projects based on the `labels` field. The operation returns only projects that match all specified selectors. The selectors are combined with a logical AND.

description.zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始
description.en: The page number to return. Defaults to 1.

description.zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100
description.en: The number of projects to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 100.
